lines.zh: 宽嘴贴地，边走边扫嫩蕨。
lines.en: Wide snout sweeping ferns as I walk.

lines.zh: 我这口细牙，专割低处的草。
lines.en: These fine teeth are made for low grass.

lines.zh: 数百颗牙一起动，草地就秃了。
lines.en: Hundreds of teeth working, the ground goes bare.

lines.zh: 低头的日子，脖子也不酸。
lines.en: Head down all day, my neck never aches.
Why hurry? Ferns cannot run.

lines.zh: 平原这么宽，够我走一天。
lines.en: The plain is wide enough for a day's walk.

lines.zh: 脚掌厚，踩碎枯枝也不怕。
lines.en: Thick feet, dry twigs snap under me.
Don't rush me; I was never built for speed.
Every three steps, one bite.

lines.zh: 身后一条秃带，是我留的路。
lines.en: The bare strip behind me is my road.

lines.zh: 平原边上的蕨最嫩，我常去。
lines.en: The ferns at the plain's edge are tenderest.
My tail swings, good for swatting flies.

lines.zh: 大个子也有大个子的慢法。
lines.en: Even a giant has a giant's way of being slow.
Where I pass, only roots remain.
Eat first at dawn; think of moving later.

lines.zh: 我这嘴像吸尘器，只是吃素。
lines.en: My mouth works like a vacuum, but vegetarian.
My weight makes the ground thud.
Step by step, chasing no one.
Standing still, I glance at the sky.
The wind blows a fern leaf to my mouth.

lines.zh: 不动的时候，我像一堵矮墙。
lines.en: Standing still, I look like a low wall.

lines.zh: 听见远处雷声，先不走了。
lines.en: Distant thunder; I stop for now.
Grass juice still lingers in my mouth.
The sun warms my back.
My eyelids droop; a short nap.
A bug is climbing my leg.

lines.zh: 呼吸慢下来，脖子也放松。
lines.en: Breathing slows, my neck relaxes.
I am counting the fern leaves ahead.

lines.zh: 静静站着，谁也注意不到我。
lines.en: Standing quietly, no one notices me.
Quiet here, good for chewing cud.
My snout twitches; wet soil smell.
My legs numb; I shift stance.
No rush to eat; I listen a while.
You stand so close — what do you want?

lines.zh: 我认得你的气味，新来的。
lines.en: I know your scent; you're new.

lines.zh: 抬头看你，脖子有点费劲。
lines.en: Lifting my head to see you takes effort.

lines.zh: 别摸我的嘴，那里全是牙。
lines.en: Don't touch my mouth; it's all teeth.
You're a good deal shorter than me.
My eye rolls toward you and stays.
Do you want grass, or me?
Neutral doesn't mean easy prey.

lines.zh: 你手里没吃的，我失望了。
lines.en: Empty hands — how disappointing.
Stand back; my tail is long.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的工夫，我又低头了。
lines.en: Before you blink, my head drops again.

lines.zh: 看够了没有，我要吃草了。
lines.en: Seen enough? I'm going back to grass.
Ow! Who hit me?
Even someone my size feels pain.
Thick hide still tears.
I try to dodge, too slowly.
Not the head; my crest is fragile.
A grunt, and I give half a step.
This will take a while to heal.
The pain makes my tail lash.
You picked the wrong giant.
Blood runs; I'll walk it off.
That bundle of ferns — for me?

lines.zh: 叶子一晃，我脖子就伸过去。
lines.en: A leaf waves and my neck follows.

lines.zh: 你别拿走，我刚闻到香味。
lines.en: Don't take it away; I just caught the smell.

lines.zh: 我慢慢来，但一定要吃到。
lines.en: I come slowly, but I will get it.

lines.zh: 草香顺风飘过来，脚步快了。
lines.en: Grass scent on the wind speeds my step.

lines.zh: 为了这一口，走多远都行。
lines.en: For that bite, I'd walk far.
The urge to lower my head can't be helped.
Wave the leaf and I sway along.
My mouth is open — don't pull back.
This patch will keep me chewing.
I don't snatch; I wait for you to set it down.

lines.zh: 香味钻进鼻子，走不动了。
lines.en: The smell fills my snout; I can't move on.
To feed me, stand a bit higher.

lines.zh: 嫩芽在前，我眼里没别的。
lines.en: Green shoots ahead, nothing else in sight.

lines.zh: 我这么大个子，胃口更大。
lines.en: Big as I am, my appetite is bigger.
Stop teasing; drop it and go.
Bumped me? I didn't budge.
Sorry, I turn too slowly.

lines.zh: 你被我的腿绊了一下吧。
lines.en: My leg tripped you, didn't it?
I'm too big to dodge.
Make way; I'm heading to grass.
Don't push; pushing does nothing.
I'm all bone; the ache is yours.

lines.zh: 我听见你撞上来的闷响。
lines.en: I heard the dull thump of you hitting me.
On this path, I take the middle.
Squeeze in; we'll both pass.
Spring is here; I want a companion.

lines.zh: 那边那位，尾巴摇得不错。
lines.en: Over there — nice tail swing.

lines.zh: 我们并肩吃草，也算约会。
lines.en: Grazing side by side counts as a date.
Do you like low ferns too?
I approach slowly, not to startle her.
Two long necks, winding together.
Quiet around here, good for nesting.
I rumble; she rumbles back.
Walking together, both our steps slow.
With a mate, even grass tastes better.
This fallen leaf — I'll take it.
My wide mouth scoops it right up.
Whose pit is this? Mine now.
I pick it up and swallow slowly.
A tender twig on the ground — perfect.
One dip of my head and it's held fast.
Don't laugh at how slowly I pick things up.
This mouthful will last me half a day.

lines.zh: 我的嘴很宽，捡东西不漏。
lines.en: My wide mouth misses nothing.
After this bite, I move on.
Who's in the grass? I see you.

lines.zh: 你这身板，不像来吃草的。
lines.en: You don't look like you came to graze.

lines.zh: 目标锁定，虽然我走不快。
lines.en: Target locked, though I'm not fast.
I raise my neck, ready.
I'll remember that sound.
Don't lean into my mouth.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在两侧，看得广。
lines.en: My eyes sit wide; I see a lot.
That shape ahead — a wolf?
Decided: you're the one I watch.
Still following? I haven't turned.
I back away step by step; don't press.
I'm watching; don't circle behind.
My breathing deepens — a warning.
My tail is sweeping; mind it.
If you lunge, I'll shove.
I don't run because I can't.
Across this gap, nobody moves.
Waiting for me to slip? Keep waiting.

lines.zh: 我一直看着，眼睛都不眨。
lines.en: I keep watching without blinking.
Tail swing! That one lands heavy.
I turn my skull and ram with bone.
One stomp and the ground shakes.
My foreleg comes down — back off!

lines.zh: 我这体重，撞一下就知道。
lines.en: With my weight, one hit tells you.

lines.zh: 咬是不咬的，推也要推走你。
lines.en: I don't bite, but I'll shove you off.
A bellow, then a shove.
Thick hide; your hits hardly matter.
I hit and retreat — don't chase.

lines.zh: 我从白垩纪的平原走来。
lines.en: I come from the plains of the Cretaceous.

lines.zh: 草叶分开，我踩进这个世界。
lines.en: Grass parts as I step into this world.
A new place again; first, find ferns.

lines.zh: 长脖子先探出来，身体随后。
lines.en: Neck first, then the rest of me.
The ground dips slightly — I've arrived.

lines.zh: 谁把这么大的我放进来的？
lines.en: Who put something this big here?

lines.zh: 尼日尔的阳光，这里也差不多。
lines.en: Niger's sun feels much the same here.
I plant my feet before eating.

lines.zh: 一群小动物被我吓跑了。
lines.en: A crowd of small animals scatters.

lines.zh: 我这一身，从骨头到皮都沉。
lines.en: Everything about me is heavy.

lines.zh: 慢慢走，世界就慢慢展开。
lines.en: Walk slowly and the world unfolds slowly.

lines.zh: 热浪烤着我的背，快躲开。
lines.en: The heat sears my back — get away.
I fell from a height; my legs buckle.

lines.zh: 水灌进长嘴，我喘不上气。
lines.en: Water fills my long snout; I can't breathe.
My teeth are a rake.
Strange force seeps into my bones.
The ferns are gone; my belly is empty.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我直往下坠。
lines.en: No ground under me — I fall and fall.
